meta_title: CJS Gardening Service | Landscape Gardener Leeds
meta_description: CJS Gardening Service in Leeds offers expert landscape gardening, garden design, and maintenance. Local, reliable, and fully insured. Call 07389 704596 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured Landscape Gardener — 15+ Years Local Experience
hero_subhead: Expert landscape design and garden maintenance that turns overgrown spaces into outdoor rooms you'll love using.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From garden design and new planting through to regular maintenance and hard landscaping — we handle every aspect of outdoor space creation and care.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden design tailored to your space, lifestyle, and budget. We produce detailed plans and handle all planting selection to create a garden that grows beautifully year-round.

services.title: New Garden Builds
services.desc: Complete garden construction including paving, decking, fencing, borders, and planting. We manage the whole project from soil preparation to final planting.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or monthly garden care including grass cutting, hedge trimming, border maintenance, and seasonal tidying. Keeps your garden looking immaculate without the stress.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Cutting
services.desc: Professional hedge and shrub trimming to shape, maintain, and rejuvenate overgrown growth. Safe, tidy work that promotes healthy new growth.

services.title: Patio & Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Supply and installation of paving, decking, gravel, steps, and garden structures. Creates durable outdoor spaces that blend seamlessly with planted areas.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Complete garden clearance and waste removal for overgrown spaces. We leave your garden clean, level, and ready for new planting or landscaping.

about_pullquote: I started this because Leeds deserves gardens that work as hard as the people who live here.
about_para_1: CJS Gardening Service was founded over 15 years ago by a landscape gardener with a real passion for outdoor spaces. What began as a one-man operation has grown steadily through word-of-mouth and repeat customers across Leeds and the surrounding areas. We combine hands-on experience with design expertise — every project, whether a small tidy-up or a full garden build, gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, honest pricing, and gardens that actually get used. We listen to what you want your space to do, source quality materials, and finish cleanly. Most of our new work comes from recommendations by existing customers — that's how we know we're doing it right.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an absolute jungle at the back when we moved in. CJS came round, listened to what we wanted, and completely transformed it. The design works brilliantly — the family actually uses the garden now. Tidy workers, fair price, would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using CJS for regular maintenance for three years now. Always on time, always professional. The garden looks incredible every season. You can tell he actually cares about the work, not just rushing to the next job.
reviews.author: Rachel H.

reviews.text: Got a quote same day, price was competitive and realistic. Work started when promised, finished early, and the clearance and new planting look immaculate. Would definitely book again.
reviews.author: David K.
